PrismaClient: @prisma/client: the client class a project may extend
$transaction: @prisma/client: client method that runs a callback with a client for the transaction, or an array of calls
connectOrCreate: @prisma/client: nested write operation, insert the row when the lookup misses
connect: @prisma/client: nested write operation, join an existing row
disconnect: @prisma/client: nested write operation, drop a joined row
set: language: JavaScript spells Map#set the same way. @prisma/client: nested write operation, replace the joined rows
data: @prisma/client: write argument key holding the row values
where: @prisma/client: argument key holding the filter that picks the rows
some: @prisma/client: list relation filter, some related row matches a where
every: @prisma/client: list relation filter, every related row matches a where
is: @prisma/client: single relation filter, the related row matches a where
isNot: @prisma/client: single relation filter, the related row does not match a where
AND: @prisma/client: where operator, every listed filter matches
OR: @prisma/client: where operator, some listed filter matches
NOT: @prisma/client: where operator, the listed filters do not match
lte: suss: comparison the IR spells the same way. @prisma/client: column filter operator
gte: suss: comparison the IR spells the same way. @prisma/client: column filter operator
mode: @prisma/client: column filter option, case sensitivity of a string filter
isSet: @prisma/client: composite or optional column filter operator
schema: prisma: prisma.config.ts key and package.json prisma key giving the schema's path
generator: prisma: schema block declaring a client generator
output: prisma: generator block key giving the directory the client is written to
assignment: @mrleebo/prisma-ast: node type for a key and value inside a schema block
runtime: prisma: folder of the library's own code inside a generated client
